customer.producer.spotlight.anna.bio: Anna took over the farm from her father in 2018 and switched to community-supported agriculture overnight. She grows twenty-five vegetables on 1.8 hectares, none of which see a spray.
customer.producer.spotlight.anna.name: Anna Schmitz
customer.producer.spotlight.anna.quote: We don't spray anything. If we wouldn't eat it ourselves, it doesn't go in your box.
customer.producer.spotlight.elena.bio: Elena runs a twelve-cow creamery on the edge of the Spree forest. Her fresh cheese ripens in clay jars, her semi-hard rounds spend four months on spruce boards.
customer.producer.spotlight.elena.name: Elena Kowalski
customer.producer.spotlight.elena.quote: Twelve cows, four months of maturing. Cheese takes time, and we have it.
customer.producer.spotlight.jakob.bio: Fourth generation on the same field. Jakob cuts daily between April and June and the spears reach Berlin twelve hours later. What arrives on your Wednesday was still under foil on Tuesday.
customer.producer.spotlight.jakob.name: Jakob Reuter
customer.producer.spotlight.jakob.quote: Cut this morning, with you by tonight. That's how asparagus should be.
customer.producer.spotlight.marcus.bio: Marcus fishes with traps, no nets, no engines on the lake itself. What nature gives him reaches our vans the same afternoon. Some weeks plenty, some weeks little.
customer.producer.spotlight.marcus.name: Marcus Lindemann
customer.producer.spotlight.marcus.quote: Traps, not nets. Sometimes many, sometimes few, always honest.
customer.producer.spotlight.sophia.bio: Eighty hens, a hectare of pasture, a rooster named Otto. Sophia's eggs nearly always carry traces of soil, that's by design and a good sign.
customer.producer.spotlight.sophia.name: Sophia Berger
customer.producer.spotlight.sophia.quote: Eighty hens, one hectare of meadow. Soil on the egg is on purpose.
customer.producer.spotlight.thomas.bio: Thomas bakes only three loaves: a rye, a sourdough, a spelt. All from regional flour, all rested overnight in the cold room, baked four hours before your delivery.
customer.producer.spotlight.thomas.name: Thomas Bäcker
customer.producer.spotlight.thomas.quote: Three breads. Rested overnight. Baked four hours before delivery.

customer.story.box.this_week_lead_1: This week from four farms within eighty kilometres. Harvested between Sunday and Wednesday, composed on Thursday afternoon, with you at the start of the week.
customer.story.box.this_week_lead_2: A restrained box, the bridge between winter roots and first spring shoots is narrow, but it has character. What's here is here on purpose.
customer.story.box.this_week_lead_3: A generous week: every farm is harvesting at once, the basket fills itself. We picked variety over volume, six kinds, all at full ripeness.
customer.story.box.this_week_lead_4: There was frost on the field this morning, the carrots taste sweeter for it. Weeks like this remind us why we don't pack the same box all year round.
customer.story.box.this_week_lead_5: A small composition with a long story: this asparagus comes from the field Jakob's grandfather laid out in 1962. Four generations, one soil.
customer.story.dashboard.founder_note_1: We're building Erdgut the way we'd want to shop: from the farm that's named after the farmer. One week at a time.
customer.story.dashboard.founder_note_2: There are no algorithms in your box. Only what ripened this week, and three people who watched it happen.
customer.story.dashboard.founder_note_3: A small selection, deliberately small. We know every farm personally, and we'd like to keep it that way.
customer.story.dashboard.founder_note_4: The best moment of the week is Thursday afternoon, when all the boxes stand together and look like a small market.
customer.story.dashboard.weekly_intro_1: This week brings the first real asparagus from Beelitz. Jakob has been out at sunrise for three weeks now, the soil is warming, the stalks are showing.
customer.story.dashboard.weekly_intro_2: Anna harvested over the weekend and drove straight to us on Monday morning. There's a calm hand and good soil in this week's box.
customer.story.dashboard.weekly_intro_3: First strawberries, smaller than usual, but only March sun makes them this sweet. We're rationing so every box gets a punnet.
customer.story.dashboard.weekly_intro_4: Bread from Thursday, cheese from Friday, eggs from Saturday. We gather slowly so your box reaches you fresh at the start of the week.
customer.story.dashboard.weekly_intro_5: Marcus checked the traps this morning, few roach, but good trout. That's the season: what comes, comes.
customer.story.dashboard.weekly_intro_6: Sophia's hens are out in the meadow again. This week's eggs taste like it, like grass, like wind, like April.

privacy.intro: This notice covers orders placed via erd-gut.de, the shop as well as the asparagus order.
privacy.section_data_body: When you order we store your name, email address, optionally a phone number, the order details (type, quantity, pickup or delivery), and, for delivery, the delivery address. Card data is processed exclusively by SumUp Limited; we never see it.
privacy.section_purpose_body: Solely to process this one order, i.e. accepting it, taking payment, delivering or arranging pickup, and any follow-up questions. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract).
privacy.section_retention_body: Order-related data is stored as long as commercial and tax-law retention periods require (typically up to 10 years). After that it is deleted.
privacy.section_rights_body: You can request access to, correction of, deletion of, or restriction of processing of your data, plus object to processing and request portability at any time. Contact kontakt@erd-gut.de.
privacy.section_third_parties_body: We do not share your data with third parties for marketing. Our payment provider is SumUp Limited. Hosting is at IONOS in Germany.
privacy.section_cookies_body: We only use strictly necessary cookies required for the ordering process: a session cookie (cart, sign-in) and a cookie to protect against cross-site request forgery. These cookies are exempt from consent under § 25 (2) TTDSG. We do not use any tracking or analytics cookies. During payment, the embedded SumUp payment service may set its own cookies required to process the payment.

shop_terms.heading: Terms and Conditions, Shop
shop_terms.intro: These terms apply to one-off orders placed through the Erdgut shop (no account, no subscription). They supplement the terms for the Erdgut box.
shop_terms.section_contact_body: The contracting party and provider is Erdgut, Berlin. For questions, defects or complaints, reach us at kontakt@erd-gut.de. We are not obliged to participate in dispute-resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board, but are willing to do so.
shop_terms.section_contract_body: The presentation of products in the shop is not a binding offer but an invitation to order. By submitting your order you make a binding offer. The contract is concluded when we confirm the order, for online payment upon confirmation of payment received, for payment on site upon confirmation of the order. You receive the confirmation by email to the address provided.
shop_terms.section_delivery_body: We currently deliver only within Berlin; alternatively, pickup is available at the stated pickup points. The relevant delivery or pickup date is chosen during checkout and stated in the confirmation. A delivery fee may apply for delivery and is shown before you complete the order. Please make sure the goods can be received on the agreed date.
shop_terms.section_prices_body: All prices are in euros and include statutory VAT. Any delivery fee is shown separately before you complete the order. Payment is made online via SumUp or, where offered, on site at pickup.
shop_terms.section_scope_body: These terms apply to all one-off orders of fresh food and other products through the Erdgut shop. By completing your order you accept them. The shop is aimed at consumers in Berlin.
shop_terms.section_vouchers_body: Vouchers and discount codes can only be redeemed within the stated validity period and only under the conditions specified in each case (e.g. minimum order value, per-person limit, total quota). Only one code can be redeemed per order. Cash payout or subsequent offsetting is excluded. If an order is cancelled or refunded, a code redeemed with it lapses or is released again.
shop_terms.section_warranty_body: Statutory warranty rights apply. Please check perishable goods immediately upon receipt and report defects promptly so we can offer a replacement or refund.
shop_terms.section_withdrawal_body: For perishable goods (e.g. fresh fruit and vegetables) there is no statutory right of withdrawal under § 312g (2) no. 2 of the German Civil Code (BGB). Where an order comprises exclusively non-perishable products, you as a consumer have the statutory right of withdrawal; in that case we will inform you separately about the details. Regardless, you can contact us at any time if there is a problem, we will find a fair solution.

spargel.story_p1: If asparagus was once considered the vegetable of lords, then Kalkwitz asparagus might well be the king among them. Rooted in the Spreewald, Max continuously refines his methods to preserve the surrounding environment and biodiversity. He is one of the few producers in Germany cultivating organic asparagus without plastic foil.
spargel.story_p2: This approach is healthier for both soil and people. It avoids microplastics and chemical residues while respecting the plant's natural rhythm. The slower growth results in a more concentrated flavour, paired with a distinctive, fresh, snappy texture.
spargel.story_p3: To preserve this character, we bring these spears directly from the field to your table. Harvested the same day or the day before, and kept carefully hydrated, they retain their natural sugars and full expression of freshness. No intermediates, no long detours, just flavour at its peak.

terms.intro: These terms govern the Erdgut Box (trial box and subscription) and delivery in Berlin. A complete, counsel-reviewed version follows before the regular launch.
terms.section_billing_body: Payment runs through SumUp via a recurring charge mandate that you authorise. Each delivery is charged before it ships. Amounts and dates are visible in your account under 'Subscription'. If a charge fails we retry; if it remains unsuccessful we automatically pause the subscription.
terms.section_cancellation_body: You can skip individual weeks, pause the subscription, or cancel it entirely, at any time from your account. Already-charged weeks whose box has already been packed cannot be cancelled. The trial box is a single order, not a subscription.
terms.section_contact_body: For questions or complaints reach us at kontakt@erd-gut.de. We are not obliged to participate in dispute-resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board, but are willing to do so.
terms.section_delivery_body: We currently deliver only in Berlin, Wednesday 12:00–16:00. Delivery days and windows may expand; the binding current state is shown in your account. The delivery address is set during onboarding and can be changed up until the box is packed.
terms.section_scope_body: These conditions apply to all orders placed via erd-gut.de, both the one-time trial box and the recurring subscription. Placing the order or making payment constitutes acceptance. The contract partner is Erdgut, Berlin (contact: kontakt@erd-gut.de).
terms.section_subscription_body: The subscription runs weekly or every two weeks, depending on your choice. Contents and price per delivery follow the chosen box size (Small, Medium, Large). We curate contents seasonally; individual products may vary. Allergies are honoured during composition.
